editorial.copyrightPolicy: Publisher article text and reviews are never copied; current topics are explained in Swoon'd's own words with a link to the original. Manufacturer press images are not used.

masteryModel.usefulCompetenceStatement: She can follow a car conversation, understand what her person's car is and why they love it, ask a couple of good questions about the build or the drive, and say 'okay, I get why you love this' without faking it.

licensingConstraints.constraint: Original illustrations only (license original-swoond): archetypes, feature callouts and stylized composites. No manufacturer or press photos. Real-model silhouettes are gated on counsel review of design-patent and trade-dress risk.
No manufacturer logos, badges or wordmark artwork in lesson art; names appear as text facts only.
Original synthesized or self-recorded engine and motor notes only; no manufacturer, broadcast or video-platform audio; every clip has a text description.
No embedded video; deep-link to official pages.
Never copy publisher text, reviews or third-party ratings; explain in our own words and link.

NHTSA and EPA/DOE data are US government sources (check dataset terms; AFDC needs a key and attribution); Open Charge Map needs attribution; valuation data (KBB, Hagerty, Edmunds) needs partner agreements; no scraping of auction sites.
No celebrity or owner likeness; names as facts only.

safetyConstraints: Swoon'd builds appreciation, not driving instruction: no content teaches fast, drift or race driving on public roads; track days and autocross are described as organized events with safety gear.
Modding content never explains removing emissions or safety equipment and stresses warranty, insurance, inspection and legality.
Never teach lifting a car without stands, high-voltage EV work, fuel handling or airbag work; awareness only with a safety note.
Towing and off-road content follows vehicle placards and owner's manuals; the truck-offroad branch needs a qualified safety review before release.
Driver-assist copy states that current consumer systems require an attentive driver.
Buying and financing lessons explain trade-offs and are not financial advice.
Never encourage the learner to fake ownership or expertise with the person they care about.
